document.title: PMK 81/2024: Ketentuan perpajakan dalam rangka Coretax

delta.note: PMK 81/2024 regulates tax administration for the Coretax system: registration, payment, reporting (SPT Masa PPh 21/26, Unifikasi, PPN), installment and postponement of payments, and related forms. The shown provisions on PPh 21 concern reporting deadlines and SPT obligations, including the definition of the last tax period when a permanent employee stops working. None of them changes rates, tables, thresholds, deductions, or calculation steps for PPh 21 on permanent employees. This is administrative/reporting only, so it is not relevant.
